title: PhysxAutoDeformableHexahedralMeshAPI
summary: Makes the automatic cook of a volume deformable build a hexahedral (voxel) simulation mesh that embeds the collision tetrahedral mesh. Listing the API is what enables it; it is read only for a volume body that also lists PhysxAutoDeformableBodyAPI.
producer_scope: Published like any applied physics API: every declared attribute at its resolved value. No column is rewritten or created by the producer.

columns.name: physxDeformableBody:resolution
columns.absent: 0: the cooker uses 10 hexahedral elements along the longest edge. Authored values from 1 to 3 are raised to 4.
columns.notes: A cooking input only: a change resyncs the deformable body and is one of the cooker's recook triggers. Ignored for a surface body. With mesh simplification on, the resolved resolution also sets the simplification target edge length.

interactions.rule: Read only inside the PhysxAutoDeformableBodyAPI read and only for a volume body (simulation mesh with OmniPhysicsVolumeDeformableSimAPI); a surface body ignores the API.
